# Identifiers defined OUTSIDE this repository that docs cite on purpose.
#
# Read by scripts/docs_lint_fact_checks.py (EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIERS_FILE): the
# dead-identifier check does not report a name listed here. One name per line;
# text after `#` is a comment. Every name sits under a comment naming where it is
# defined, and was checked to be absent from this repo's code before it was added.
#
# Never add a name this repo defines or used to define: the list would then hide
# its rename. A name that is only absent because it is planned belongs in a doc
# with a `Status: planned` line, not here.
